_doc: W17.3 cel-spec upstream pin record (VAL-W17-010). celspec_commit_sha is the commit google/cel-spec tag v0.20.0 points at; it MUST equal the first non-comment line of PINNED_COMMIT.txt (the drift checker asserts the equality) and the nightly workflow asserts it resolves on the cel-spec remote. The corpus is regenerated from this exact commit by scripts/build-celspec-corpus.py. The cel-python and cel-js fields record the pinned (NOT latest) runtime versions used for the per-PR conformance run; the nightly drift workflow (.github/workflows/nightly-cel-drift.yml) compares against the LATEST versions on PyPI/npm per VAL-W17-014. Rotating the pin REQUIRES re-running the generator (rewrites MANIFEST.sha256 + celspec_vectors.json + relay-profile-filter.yaml) and bumping last_refreshed_at.
